_comment: The debug scenes the Placeholder Matrix (matrix.lua) lists, in order. stage = the Lua stage folder it opens; price = coins to unlock it once per save (0 = open from the start).

scenes.name: Demo1
scenes.desc: The first demo using Lua stages.

scenes.name: Demo2
scenes.desc: Was used to debug and test song lists.

scenes.name: Demo3
scenes.desc: Was used to debug and test databases.

scenes.name: Theme Settings Test
scenes.desc: Shows the current theme settings values and specifications.

scenes.name: Dan Plate Test
scenes.desc: Shows multiple dan plates with different styling.

scenes.name: Gradient Map Test
scenes.desc: Shows P1 character with 3 different colour palettes.

scenes.name: Canvas Test
scenes.desc: A tiny paint program: draw on a white sheet with the mouse, demonstrating the LuaCanvas + mouse input.

scenes.name: Voxel Engine
scenes.desc: A voxel world rendered via a Lua3DScene window.

scenes.name: Particle Showcase
scenes.desc: A stress test of the Lua3DScene particle engine.

scenes.name: Modal Test
scenes.desc: Plays the reward and unlock modals of every rarity and type.

scenes.name: Video Player
scenes.desc: The boot intro in a player: play, pause, seek on the timeline, speed and volume.
